transition_18a: MATERIAL DIFFERENCE: under former 18-A the elective share was a flat 1/3 of the augmented estate; under 18-C §2-202 it is 50% of the MARITAL-PROPERTY PORTION of the augmented estate, which scales with length of marriage (§2-203). Date of death selects which regime applies. Title 18-C applies to estates of decedents who die on or after 2019-09-01, and to any proceeding pending on or commenced after that date. For a decedent who died before 2019-09-01, former Title 18-A supplies the substantive succession rules even though the proceeding itself runs under 18-C. See _index/18a-key-diffs.json (governing rule: 18-C §8-301).

caselaw.name: Estate of Fisher
caselaw.holding: In satisfying the surviving spouse's elective share, the court must determine the sources from which the share is payable and value property passing to the spouse that is charged against the share. NOTE: decided under the former 18-A elective-share regime (flat 1/3 of the augmented estate); 18-C replaced that with 50% of the marital-property portion (§2-202/§2-203), so the computation differs for deaths on/after 2019-09-01.

caselaw.name: Estate of Galluzzo
caselaw.topic: Elective share — augmented estate; timing of petition
caselaw.holding: Addressed what property is included in the augmented estate and the elective-share petition in an estate. NOTE: decided under the former 18-A flat-1/3 elective-share regime; the 18-C marital-property-portion approach (§2-202/§2-203) governs deaths on/after 2019-09-01, so inclusion/valuation analysis differs.
